::: {.ctric-section}

[Who we are]{.ctric-section-tag}

## A national hub for tick science

[CTRIC is a dedicated research and commercial laboratory housed within Acadia University's Huestis Innovation Pavilion. We bring together leading researchers, government partners, and industry to tackle one of Canada's fastest-growing public health challenges. Ticks and Lyme disease now affect thousands of Canadians each year, with case counts nearly doubling between 2022 and 2024. Climate change is accelerating tick range expansion — and Canada needs a domestic centre of excellence to respond.]{.ctric-section-sub}

::: {.ctric-card-grid}

::: {.ctric-card}
**🔬 Built on proven expertise**

Our team has secured millions in external research funding and actively contributes to national surveillance networks including TickNet and e-Tick, in collaboration with the Public Health Agency of Canada and CanLyme.
:::

::: {.ctric-card}
**🏘️ Rooted in Atlantic Canada**

Located in Wolfville, NS, CTRIC creates skilled employment in rural Atlantic Canada while delivering national and international impact through research, innovation, and strategic partnerships.
:::

::: {.ctric-card}
**🛡️ Biosafety first**

CTRIC is built to Containment Level 2 (CL2) standards and registered with the Public Health Agency of Canada, ensuring the highest level of safety for staff, partners, and the environment.
:::

::: {.ctric-card}
**🔄 Reducing foreign dependency**

Canada currently relies on the Oklahoma State University facility for tick supply. CTRIC provides a Canadian-reared, locally relevant alternative — keeping research dollars at home and ensuring genetic relevance.
:::

:::

:::
:::

     WHAT WE DO

:::::: {.ctric-section .ctric-section-alt}
::::: {.ctric-container}

[What we do]{.ctric-section-tag}

## Three core service streams

[CTRIC offers specialized, fee-for-service capabilities to universities, government agencies, and industry partners across Canada and internationally.]{.ctric-section-sub}

:::: {.ctric-pillar}
[Stream 1]{.ctric-pillar-num}

::: {.ctric-pillar-body}
**Tick rearing & supply**

We rear Canadian blacklegged ticks (*Ixodes scapularis*) and dog ticks (*Dermacentor variabilis*) for supply to academic researchers, government agencies, and industry partners across Canada and internationally. Our colonies are genetically relevant to northern North American environments — something no U.S.-based supplier can offer — ensuring that research outcomes and public health responses reflect local tick biology.
:::
::::

:::: {.ctric-pillar}
[Stream 2]{.ctric-pillar-num}

::: {.ctric-pillar-body}
**Tick pathogen testing**

We detect tick-borne pathogens including *Borrelia* spp. (Lyme disease), *Anaplasma*, *Babesia*, and *Rickettsia* in submitted tick samples. Our fee-for-service testing supports universities, public health agencies, and private laboratories seeking timely and reliable results — providing a much-needed alternative as national testing capacity struggles to meet growing demand.
:::
::::

:::: {.ctric-pillar}
[Stream 3]{.ctric-pillar-num}

::: {.ctric-pillar-body}
**Repellency & acaricidal testing**

We evaluate the effectiveness of repellents, treated fabrics, and acaricidal products against live ticks under controlled laboratory conditions. Our testing generates the data required for Health Canada PMRA product registration, supporting start-ups and established companies in bringing evidence-based tick protection products to market.
:::
::::

:::::
::::::

## CTRIC and its amenities

[Our Containment Level 2 facility within Acadia's Huestis Innovation Pavilion is equipped for the full cycle of tick research — from colony establishment and rearing to molecular diagnostics and repellency trials.]{.ctric-section-sub}

::: {.ctric-amenity-grid}

::: {.ctric-amenity-card}
[🪲 Tick rearing suite]{.ctric-amenity-header}

- Environmental chamber with precise humidity & temperature control
- Hemotek® artificial blood feeding system with recirculating blood setup
- Autoclave & gravity oven for sterile conditions
- Laminar flow hood & Class II biosafety cabinet
- Water purification system (Type 1 ultrapure water)
- Stereomicroscope for tick identification and inspection
:::

::: {.ctric-amenity-card}
[🧬 Molecular diagnostics suite]{.ctric-amenity-header}

- Thermal cycler for PCR amplification
- Gel electrophoresis system for DNA/RNA separation
- Plate centrifuge & plate sealer
- Refrigerated microcentrifuge
- Multichannel micropipettors for high-throughput processing
- Dry bath heat block & pH meter for sample preparation
:::

::: {.ctric-amenity-card}
[🔒 Biosafety & containment]{.ctric-amenity-header}

- Containment Level 2 (CL2) certified laboratory space
- Registered with the Public Health Agency of Canada (PHAC)
- Dedicated HVAC system with restricted-access containment room
- Fire suppression system installed to safety standards
- Staff trained in safe handling, spill response & emergency protocols
:::

::: {.ctric-amenity-card}
[🌿 Sustainability features]{.ctric-amenity-header}

- Energy-efficient AC/heat pump system for temperature & humidity control
- All equipment selected with energy efficiency as a priority
- No live animals used — artificial membrane feeding throughout
- Green technology reduces long-term operating costs
:::
